name: ZenSched
tagline: Runs field-crew scheduling over MCP, from shift planning to GPS-verified check-in
description: Aims an agent at the field-operations loop over a remote MCP connection: opening the vendor account, adding locations and shifts, inviting crew to the mobile app, watching geofenced check-ins land, and pulling the resulting timesheets. For operators who would rather run the day in chat than in a vendor dashboard.
body:
## What it does

Aims an agent at the field-operations loop over a remote MCP connection: opening the vendor account, adding locations and shifts, inviting crew to the mobile app, watching geofenced check-ins land, and pulling the resulting timesheets. For operators who would rather run the day in chat than in a vendor dashboard.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @zensched shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
